source: Minchat Shai on Gen 47:3 (the Masorah's fullness note)
claim_en: gam AVOTENU ('both we and OUR FATHERS'): MS — this token alone is written FULL-OF-FULL in the whole Torah ('the one of "and Pharaoh said to his brothers"'), and the census verifies EXACT: one full spelling in the Torah's stream, at the performance verse — while the SCRIPT (46:34, va-amartem gam avotenu — 'you shall say... both we and our fathers') wrote the same word LEAN: the scripted answer is performed one vav FULLER than the script — the letter marking the delivery above the rehearsal (the lean six census asserted, the script's own token among them).

ROE tzon avadekha ('your servants are a SHEPHERD of flocks'): the he written at the word's end per the Masorah even though the sense is PLURAL — the brothers answer as many men in one singular noun: the letter's singular locked by the Masorah against the grammar's expectation (the plural sense carried by the sentence, the singular skeleton by the scroll).

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 47:11 (Ibn Ezra weighed and answered)
claim_en: be-eretz RAMSES ('in the land of Rameses'): ONE VOWEL SPLITS TWO PLACES — MS (against Ibn Ezra's merging) rules the ayin here SILENT (sheva) for the dwelling-district of Israel, while the STORE-CITY built under bondage (Exod 1:11) wears the ayin OPEN (patach) and 'is not the place of Israel' — and the stream verifies the whole map: sheva at the dwelling (47:11) AND at all three departure-verses (Exod 12:37, Num 33:3, 33:5 — Israel leaves FROM the sheva-place), patach at the store-city alone: the vowel keeps the two cities apart, checked at every station.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 47:18-19 (a manuscript Masorah; the Ramah)
claim_en: ADMATENU ('our ground'): the ACADEMIES' SPLIT — a manuscript Masorah MS found records Sura reading all of them LEAN and Nehardea all FULL, the dispute left standing 'UNTIL EZRA COMES' (the Masorah's own deferral formula); the Ramah rules geviyatenu ('our body') and admatenu lean, 'and all of them so written in the Torah' — and his second rule verifies to the letter: of the THREE admatenu tokens in 47:19, the first and second take NO vav at the word's head and the third takes the vav (idx6 and idx10 bare, idx14 vav'd — asserted): the stream with the Ramah, the academies' split carried named.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 47:14 (the Masorah's pair)
claim_en: BETA faro ('into the HOUSE of Pharaoh'): the phrase stands exactly TWICE in the Torah — Joseph bringing ALL the silver into Pharaoh's house (47:14) and the swarm coming 'into the house of Pharaoh' FIRST of all Egypt (Exod 8:20): the Kitzur's measure-for-measure — because the king forgot the good of the silver-bringer, the plague entered by the same door; and his second reading: as silver is stored chamber within chamber, so the swarm found the inner chamber (the pair checked by adjacency).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 47:7 (the Masorah's pair)
claim_en: va-YAAMIDEHU ('and he stood him'): exactly TWICE in the Torah — Joseph standing his old father before Pharaoh (47:7) and Moses standing Joshua before Eleazar (Num 27:22) — and BOTH written LEAN: the Kitzur — Jacob was old and needed supporting; Joshua stood abashed before his master and needed supporting: neither standing was complete, and the letter thins both (the two-token census checked).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 47:23 (the Masorah's three)
claim_en: HE lakhem zera ('BEHOLD — seed for you'): the behold-word's one Torah station (checked: Torah-unique in-stream), and the Kitzur's Masorah-file counts its Scripture-three — behold-SEED here (toward the fifth given to Pharaoh), behold-YOUR-WAY in Ezekiel (16:43), behold-the-IRON in Daniel's image (2:43, the five metals) — the five-things arithmetic he binds across the three (named beyond the Torah's stream: Ezekiel and Daniel carried by the chain).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 47:29 (the Masorah's pair; the midrash)
claim_en: va-yiqrvu yeme ('and the days drew near'): the death-approach formula opens for JACOB here — its one Torah adjacency (checked) — and its Scripture-partner is DAVID's (1 Kgs 2:1, named beyond the stream): the Kitzur's midrash — David's hundred forty-seven psalms answer Jacob's hundred forty-seven years, and each saw his son crowned in his own lifetime; and neither reached his fathers' days.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 47:26 (the galgal note)
claim_en: va-YASEM ('and he set' — the fifth made statute): MS's note reads the word WITH THE GALGAL (the rolling-wheel stroke that serves the great pazer ahead) — and SNAPSHOT writes the plain CONNECTOR (munach) at this station: a mark-split carried named, the stream's own stroke checked in-stream (the corpus's galgal census stands unchanged at its nine stations; the pazer it would serve sits two tokens on).

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 47:28 (the closed portion; the sages' reading)
claim_en: VA-YECHI ('and [Jacob] lived'): NO section break at all stands before this seder's head — not a closed gap, not an open one — 'as the sages expounded' (MS confirming from a manuscript Bible where the seder is marked but the Torah text runs unbroken): the famous SEALED PORTION — the eyes and heart of Israel closed by the exile that begins here; carried NAMED-ONLY BY DESIGN: section layout lives on the written scroll's spacing, not in the stream's character-set — the station it seals is checked in-stream.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 47:6 and 47:9 (each note doubled in the record)
claim_en: The chapter's pointing file, first half: HOSHEV ('settle!' — Pharaoh's grant) with the shin in TSERE (the causative imperative's long vowel, checked in-stream); MEGUREHEM ('their sojournings', 47:9 — Jacob's own word for his fathers' wandering years) with the gimel SOFT (asserted): the settle-word pointed long at the king's mouth, the sojourn-word soft at the wanderer's.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 47:15/18/19/24/30 (the file; Or Torah on the old codices)
claim_en: The pointing file, second half: NEGDEKHA ('before you') dalet DAGESHED; GEVIYATENU ('our body') gimel DAGESHED (checked) with admatenu ('our ground') beside it per MS; ve-TEN zera ('GIVE seed') tav in SEGOL; ve-LA-ASHER ('and for those') alef in CHATAF PATACH; and anokhi EESE ('I will do', 47:30 — Joseph's acceptance of the burial charge): MS found the OLD SEPHARAD CODICES pointing the ayin with BARE SHEVA, their margins noting 'beautifully pointed', and Or Torah concurs — while the stream writes CHATAF SEGOL: the acceptance-verb's split carried named, the stream's side asserted.

The Kitzur's number-crowns, carried NAMED-ONLY (letter-arithmetic, not stream-marks): u-mi-QETZE echav laqach ('from the EDGE of his brothers he took') = 'these are the WEAK ones' by count (the five who could not bear arms); be-METAV ha-aretz ('in the BEST of the land') = GOSHEN by count — the best of the land IS Goshen by the letters' own arithmetic; na yad-kha ('pray, your hand', 47:29) = CIRCUMCISION by count (the covenant under the thigh); EMET ('truth') read as coffin-bier-shrouds initials — the kindness-with-the-dead that is the TRUE kindness (Rashi via the Kitzur); va-YISHTACHU ('and he bowed', 47:31) = 'giving thanks for the good news' by count; the SEVENTEEN years Jacob lived in Egypt answering the seventeen he raised Joseph (the sustenance returned measure for measure); and the bed-file armed: the righteous STRENGTHEN on the bed (48:2 ahead) while Haman FALLS on it (Esth 7:8, named) — the stations checked, the arithmetic named.
